Headline: Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) In Focus After Record Fiscal Revenue And AI Security Push
Event_Summary: Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) reported record fiscal year revenue, driven by strong demand for networking and security across enterprise, service provider, and public sectors. The company is heavily focusing on AI infrastructure, security, and Splunk deployments, positioning its products as essential for large model training and high-speed data center connections. Headline: AGM Group Holdings (NasdaqCM:AGMH) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions

Headline: Financials slump amid sector rotation into technology; Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley in week's losers
Event_Summary: Wall Street saw a significant sector rotation from financials into technology, driven by increased AI spending and capital markets activity. The State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) rose while the State Street Financial Sel Sec SPDR ETF (XLF) declined, partly due to fears of AI disruption from Meta's Muse. Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley were among the biggest financial losers, while Citigroup saw gains, and several mid-cap and small-cap financial firms experienced notable shifts.
